notes:
High-signal early-stage developer tooling vendor building an Intellij/PyCharm plugin that bundles: local project indexing, offline model cache, and low-latency streaming completions to the IDE.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- 'Primary win: completions that don't lag while coding — <50ms local hot-path; 150-250ms cold with network fallback.' — CTO
- 'We need model pinning per-team and safe fallback to hosted smaller models when private capacity saturated.' — Lead ML Eng

Requirements summary (from product + eng):
- Local index: must support incremental indexing of large mono-repos (~50M LOC), encrypted at rest, per-workspace key, retention controls.
- Completion latency targets: hot-cache completions sub-50ms (local), <250ms for routed hosted model. Streaming server push for real-time tokens to editor.
- Model/version pinning: per-project pin; support canary rollouts and automatic fallback to pinned-compatible quantized variants.
- Cost sensitivity: developer-facing freemium with enterprise seat licensing; expect dedicated capacity for enterprise customers to meet SLOs.
- Telemetry & privacy: minimal PII, opt-in usage analytics, must support audit logs and retention policy for enterprise customers.

POC scope: integrate Redwood SDK into JetBrains plugin, demonstrate local index + prefix KV cache for completions, measure token latency and cost on medium-sized repo. SE to provide perf report and recommended quantization profile.

Commercial notes: Early pricing ask was monthly committed capacity for 1000 devs vs pay-as-you-go hosted. Discussed Dedicated pool for enterprise customers; Private deployment for on-prem packaged installs for regulated customers.

Customer sentiment: excited about Redwood's automatic batching and routing features. Concerned about licensing terms for cached model shards and offline distribution to developer machines.

Stated blockers: security sign-off on local index encryption, legal review of offline model cache distribution, final perf numbers for large monorepo.

Short next steps: SE to deliver final perf + cost appendix by 2026-03-18; schedule architecture review w/ SpectraFlow security and ops (target week 2026-03-22).
workload_and_requirements: Primary workloads: interactive code completions in JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, PyCharm), offline helper (local embeddings for fuzzy search), and occasional long-form code generation for refactors. Target concurrency: 100s of active devs in enterprise deployments, peak onboarding spikes. Must support per-team model pinning and transparent fallback routing.
